The error was a false positive: the word "input" appears in the comments, and the safety checker rejects it. I've removed it. I also raised the output stage gm/Id so the swing holds at a 1.62 V supply, and lowered gbw_t to 28 MHz to protect phase margin.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Program rejected because comments contained the forbidden token 'input'. Removed it, raised second-stage gm/Id for swing at 1.62 V, cleaned up the CMRR/noise predictions and widened the L bounds for flicker noise."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # diff pair L (flicker noise / gain)
    "itail": (80e-6, 40e-6, 160e-6),
    "gmid4": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS load and M7 gm/Id (matched Vsg -> low offset)
    "L4":    (0.5, 0.35, 1.0),
    "i7":    (200e-6, 120e-6, 350e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS mirror L
    "gbw_t": (28e6, 20e6, 45e6),     # design GBW
    "rz_k":  (1.2, 0.6, 2.0),        # Rz scale vs. zero-cancel value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    it, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    gmid_n = 12.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], it / 2, vds=0.6)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i7, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], it, vds=0.4)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["gbw_t"])
    c1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    rz = p["rz_k"] * (1 + (cl + c1) / cc) / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "z", rz)
    n.C("CC", "z", "vout", cc)

    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cl + cc * (c1 + cl)))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    denom = cc * (1 / m7.gm - rz)
    zr = 1 / (2 * PI * denom) if abs(denom) > 1e-30 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / zr))
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    power = 1.8 * (iref + it + i7)
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m3.gm / (m5.gds + 1e-12) * gm1 / (gm1 + 1e-12))
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = vn_th * 8

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "swing": swing,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
```
